title: Glasgow's 'most haunted' building that's behind a busy shopping centre
excerpt: "We have experienced things that there is no explanations for."
content:
"We have experienced things that there is no explanations for."

15:03, 20 Sep 2026

Scotland is infamous for its countless buildings and sites that are said to be haunted, with most situated in remote locations. However, a historic structure right beside a popular shopping complex in Glasgow is said to be "one of the most haunted buildings" in the city.

On Saturday, September 12, digital content creator Sneaky Sweeno shared a video showing Provan Hall next to the Glasgow Fort outdoor shopping mall. The footage, which was captured by a drone, shows how close the supposedly haunted site is to one of the city's biggest shopping destinations.

Alongside the footage, Sneaky Sweeno posted: "One of Glasgow's oldest buildings. Provan Hall is known as one of Glasgow's most haunted buildings. Some of the stonework has markings known as witch marks, which were traditionally believed to offer protection from evil."

Provan Hall is comprised of two separate buildings that are owned by the National Trust for Scotland and leased by Glasgow City Council. The two category A listed buildings, which surround a courtyard, have recently been renovated and are now operated as a small museum.

The site that Provan Hall is situated on was previously owned by Glasgow Cathedral between the 12th and 16th centuries. According to local organisation the Provan Hall Community Management Trust, the oldest sections of the current buildings are believed to date back to the late-15th century.

‌

Provan Hall is believed by many locals to be haunted, with "multiple ghost-hunting groups hailing it as one of the most active sites in Scotland for the paranormal". The building hosts tours where visitors can learn more about the supposed ghost sightings.

Five different ghostly figures are said to have been observed at Provan Hall, as well as a strange man's face peering out from one of its windows. Other visitors have reportedly heard unexplained shouts and voices, while some have even reported feeling touched by a ghostly presence.

According to legend, Provan Hall was once the scene of a gruesome double murder involving a soldier returning from war. After two years away, he came home to find that his wife had a child and in response he is said to have killed them both in anger. Ever since, their ghosts are believed to haunt the site.

‌

Speaking to Glasgow City Council in 2023, Janice Murdoch-Richards of Lanarkshire Paranormal commented: "Provan Hall is a very active paranormal location. It is a known hotspot. We have experienced things that there is no explanations for at that site. Once we asked if there was anyone there, and a lace table cloth floated up into the air and landed on the table.

"People also talk about feeling touched by someone when there is no-one close by and people have run out of the old dairy screaming because a man's face appeared from nowhere. There have also been sightings of the little boy and his mother who were murdered there."
